central_handoff.body:
Follow-up consumer receiving for MolSysMT #524 is now public on main at `dd60ee7d6855a21f24759def1d387abfbbb6a818`; independent GitHub retrieval matches all 16 files in this checkpoint, following the separately verified 24-file OpenMM block at `4d1d5949aa6a717000ac5d01a6a818f0cc99aa5d`.

- Optional OpenMM is `>=8.2.0`: native export always passes `formalCharge`, including unknown values. Exact public 8.2.0/Python 3.12 and 8.6.1/Python 3.14 each pass the same 2,098 selected provider cases. Consumer metadata/copy omissions found during receiving were repaired and #625/#626 are closed with maintained guards.
- Optional PDBFixer is `>=1.11`: the public pH hydrogen route on capped alanine reproduces incomplete ACE/NME with 1.10 (15 rather than 22 atoms); 1.11 completes the caps and parameterizes 22 particles. Final 1.11/OpenMM 8.2 and 1.12/OpenMM 8.6.1 profiles each pass 172 cases. This is the legacy pH route; explicit fixed-state H completion still requires RDKit.
- OpenMMTools has no supported runtime consumer and leaves the runtime soft extra/DepDigest registry. Historical unexported dynamics drafts remain unsupported. Plotly leaves runtime declarations and is retained in the docs extra/docs environment plus annotated development acquisition for its NGLView contact-map generator.

The authoritative values remain in pyproject.toml; development/test acquisition and names-only coverage are aligned. The controlled ArgDigest receiver also carries the accepted OpenMM/MDTraj minima. Another 625 registry/route/documentation controls and all 14 fast gates pass. Source receipts retain public artifact hashes/origins, original failures, a corrected evidence-file collision, warnings and scope: `devtools/data/openmm_runtime_receiving_524_20261106.json` and `devtools/data/pdbfixer_runtime_receiving_524_20261106.json`.

Please refresh the central dependency graph/adoption view against these published declarations. That owner-side refresh is requested, not claimed complete here. MolSysMT #524 stays partial for the remaining optional API review and actual Viewer/clean installed closure; this checkpoint does not qualify a new installed MolSysMT/Viewer pair.
